questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is not a motivation for utilising aid as an economic policy for
security?

options.A: To reward recipients for the cessation of negative behaviour, such as human rights abuses.
options.B: To incentivise recipients to act in ways beneficial to the donor.
options.C: Compassion for the human suffering of others.
options.D: To influence recipients or potential recipients through granting or denying aid.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Compassion for the human suffering of others.

questions.stem_text: What is meant by a grand strategy of 'primacy'?

options.A: Assurance of US parity with other powers
options.B: Striving for American dominance in the international system
options.D: Promotion of America as the world's first democracy

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Striving for American dominance in the international system
